description: This file defines the ProcessHost class responsible for managing a child process, including starting, messaging, and handling process exit events within the Playwright testing framework.

classes.name: ProcessHost
classes.description: Manages a child process, handles IPC communication, process lifecycle, and event emission.

methods.name: startRunner
methods.description: Starts the child process with specified runner parameters and options for stdout/stderr handling.

methods.name: sendMessage
methods.description: Sends a message to the child process and returns a promise that resolves or rejects based on the response.

methods.name: protected sendMessageNoReply
methods.description: Sends a message without expecting a reply, catching any errors silently.

methods.name: protected async onExit
methods.description: Placeholder for cleanup logic upon process exit.

methods.name: stop
methods.description: Stops the child process gracefully by sending a stop message and waiting for exit.

methods.name: didSendStop
methods.description: Returns whether a stop message has been sent to the process.

methods.name: producedEnv
methods.description: Returns the environment variables produced by the process.

methods.name: private send
methods.description: Sends a message to the child process, with debug logging.
